call_input.prompt:
Create exactly ONE finished single flat portrait poster, aspect ratio 4:5, for the fictional folding cup described below. No mockup, no multi-panel sheet, no border frame. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

User request and exact mandatory conditions:
덕테이프 포스터로 가상의 접이식 컵 출시 포스터를 만들어줘.
This role produces ONLY one of the requested two independent posters; make ONE 4:5 poster now.
실물 촬영 같은 제품 사진이 들어가야 해.
제품은 손잡이가 없는 350mL 컵으로, 몸체는 짙은 녹색 실리콘이고 뚜껑은 반투명 흰색이야.
실제 브랜드나 로고를 쓰지 말고 제품 표면에는 글자를 넣지 마.
The capacity is supplied copy only; do not add any claim of measured capacity, performance, certification or verified physical operation.

Print exactly these seven text items ONCE each, with every Korean syllable, capitalization, space, punctuation, date, unit, en dash and URL preserved. Do not print the quote marks or these instructions:
FOLN
Fold Cup
가볍게 접고, 다시 펼치다
350 mL · 접이식 실리콘 컵
2026.12.01 RELEASE
온라인 사전 주문 11.10–11.30
foln.example/store

Specific visual idea: two heights of the SAME fictional cup determine the photograph and typography together. Show one expanded and one collapsed state in one physically coherent, photo-like product studio scene. This is a state comparison, with no person or hand. The wide one-line title "Fold Cup" unites the complete combined width of the two cup states. The lower collapsed state frees space for the complete Korean line and specification near its top, leading continuously into the release, preorder and URL underneath the products. All seven copy items belong to one connected composition; avoid a separate name column, unrelated giant empty field, isolated footer banner or decorative labels. The two-state comparison must remain clear without invented state labels or arrows.

Product geometry: handleless dark forest-green silicone 350mL cup, broad round upper rim, continuous soft horizontal folding sections, gently tapering body, flat base. Same-diameter circular translucent-white lid. Show the same lid design and rim diameter in both heights. The extended body has a small number of believable broad continuous folding bellows, smoothly molded as one piece, no hinge, no rigid stacked disks. The collapsed cup is visibly lower because those same fold sections nest; keep the base and upper rim consistent. Both lids are seated, thin molded translucent milk-white silicone/plastic, a simple rounded edge without a spout or holes. No glyphs, embossing, numbers, logo, branding or marks on either cup or lid. No extra product or prop.

Art direction: a close, real-product-shoot-like image, crisp but not computer-polished. Expanded cup on the left and collapsed cup on the right share a common floor contact baseline; both objects sit fully inside the frame. Slightly elevated front three-quarter camera angle reveals both lids as consistent ellipses, with the cups upright and the same perspective. Large soft light from upper left, gentle falloff, matte green silicone with subtle fine surface texture, translucent pale lids with soft rim transmission, modest natural contact shadows. No metallic sheen or impossible glowing edges. A quiet cool pale stone/mint studio background and floor, with one coherent background, gives the dark green body real edge contrast.

Typography and composition: dark green near-black clean contemporary sans-serif. "Fold Cup" is a large, substantial one-line title spanning the two-state group width, integrated closely above the product scene. "FOLN" is a compact supplied text word at the top left, never an invented logo and never on the product. The pair of cup silhouettes and title are the first read. Place "가볍게 접고, 다시 펼치다" and "350 mL · 접이식 실리콘 컵" in the space directly above the shorter right cup, large enough to read, as two intact horizontal lines. That space exists because the cup folds. Under the shared cup baseline, align "2026.12.01 RELEASE", then "온라인 사전 주문 11.10–11.30", then "foln.example/store" with calm tight grouping and deliberate shared alignment. Keep all required copy legible without overlap, clipping or a tiny footer. Give the URL a meaningful readable size. Do not add any other visible text, price, description, title repetition, microtext, badges, decorative symbols, watermarks, extra lines or explanatory copy. The only symbols printed are those inside the exact mandatory copy above.

Render the entire single flat poster with the photograph and typography together natively.
